caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic jug placed centrally against a plain, off-white background. The jug is bulbous with a narrow neck, widening towards the middle and tapering again at the base. It has a single, thick handle connecting the neck to the upper body. The surface of the jug is textured and displays various earthy tones, including muted browns, grays, and spots of bluish-gray. There are areas of subtle shading and highlights that suggest light reflecting off the curved surfaces, and some darker patches or stains are visible on the body. The mouth of the jug is open, encircled by ridge-like rings, and the handle is robust and smoothly curved. The edges are well-defined, with no other objects or decorations present in the composition.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
